description: Patch bay and mixer, sixteen inputs by eight outputs, with a level for every crossing and sixteen stored snapshots of the whole grid

params.text: Arms the copy on the first press, and pastes the copied snapshot into the snapshot now selected on the second press
Scales the first two outputs, which are meant as the main pair, from silence to unity
Sets how long the levels take to slide when a new snapshot is brought in, from an instant jump to a slow crossfade
Clears every input mute at once
Clears every input solo at once
Clears every output mute at once
Links that pair of inputs, so muting or soloing one does the same to the other
Silences that output, and stops it being written into snapshots while it is muted
Silences that input across all eight outputs
Solos that input, so only the soloed inputs are heard across all eight outputs
Recalls that snapshot, bringing in the whole grid of levels stored in it
Sets how much of that input goes to that output, silent at one end and unity at the other
Keeps the grid stored into the selected snapshot as it is edited, with no need to press SAVE
Stores the grid as it stands into the selected snapshot

inputs.text: 0V to 10V selects the snapshot, and while anything is patched here the snapshot buttons are ignored
One of the sixteen signals being routed, taken to any of the eight outputs by the levels in its column

outputs.text: The sum of every input, each at the level set for this output

notes: every level in the grid comes up at zero, so nothing reaches the outputs until levels are turned up
hold shift while dragging a level and the level on the paired output takes the same value, outputs 1 and 2 being a pair, 3 and 4, and so on
where a pair of inputs is linked, a shift-drag on one of their levels moves the linked input's level on the paired output instead
